attributes.action: Social media ban for only U13’s not U16’s
attributes.additional_details:
Do not ban social media or other apps for under 16’s but officially ban for under 13’s.
changes to apps could be made to make them safer but don’t completely cut it out, it’s not fair. It should be up to the parents, not the government on how often their child uses social media and how safe they are being. bullying doesn’t just happen online, if you want to stop it then banning social media isn’t the answer, actually do something helpful. bullying is more common in real life than online.
attributes.background: Do not ban social media or other apps for under 16’s but officially ban for under 13’s.

rejection.details:
We already have e petition open on this which you may wish to sign:
